title: openai/codex-security
lede: Codex Security is OpenAI's CLI and TypeScript SDK for scanning a repository for vulnerabilities, validating what it finds and drafting patches, from inside Codex, a terminal or CI.

points: Scans whole repos, chosen paths or a Git diff; deep mode repeats standard scans and dedupes the results.
Validates candidate findings, generates patches, checks existing fixes and drafts SECURITY.md policies.
Exports SARIF, JSON and CSV, and can file findings in Linear, Jira or GitHub.
A GitHub Action runs scheduled scans; the example workflow caps each scan at an estimated $5.
Besides OpenAI, scans can run on Amazon Bedrock, OpenRouter, Fireworks AI and Cheaper Inference.
